language_task: Pick up the green cup and stack it on the purple.
outcome_evidence: The cups begin separate in top at frame 0. The robot acquires the green cup and carries it toward the purple cup, visible in right_wrist and top at frames 139–194, then lowers and releases it at frames 232–269. After the gripper withdraws, left_wrist clearly shows the green cup stacked on the purple cup at frames 325–349; the stack remains upright and unsupported by the gripper through frame 749. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
